corrected_rationale: Researcher personally reviewed the Phase 11.4 video evidence and confirmed: the train (locomotive) is already visible at frame zero of the front-camera recording. T0 must be treated as left-censored (recorded at the recording-relative frame-0 value per convention), consistent with the other 20/23 train events, not as a genuine late, non-left-censored arrival at t=1.5s.
